name: Miffy Englefield
bio: Miffy Englefield (born Rebecca Lauren P. Englefield, 20 March 1999 in Basingstoke, Hampshire, England) – British child actress, best known for playing Sophie (Jude Law's daughter) in The Holiday (2006) directed by Nancy Meyers, alongside Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, and Jack Black.  She also appeared as Amelia Anderson in Casualty (2008–2010, 12 episodes), Ruby in The Whistleblowers (2007), and in the short film Beautiful Enough (2011). She stopped acting around 2011 and has since pursued music and other work. She has a daughter, Frankie, born in 2022.

credits.title: Beautiful Enough
credits.overview: When a young girl, fixated on images of beautiful women, hears her parents go to bed she sets to work on her secret project.

credits.title: The Holiday
credits.overview: Two women, one American and one British, swap homes at Christmastime following bad breakups. Each woman finds romance with a local man but realizes that the imminent return home may end the relationship.
